$Comment: Resistance to fall damage the carrier takes, in whole percent points (50 halves each fall). Any item's StatModifiers raise it like any stat (Additive on the Max), and two items carrying it add up. The game reads resistance only from worn armor and active effects, so ziggfreed-common keeps a hidden always-on effect on the player carrying this much DamageResistance on exactly the Fall cause, and the game sums it with any other. Fall damage grows with the player's max Health, so a percent here keeps its worth as Health grows. Held so the sum stays under DamageResistMax: a fall that would hurt still lands for at least a point, so it never becomes immunity. There is no fall damage bonus, only this. Base 0; Min is a generous negative so a subtractive modifier never clamps, and a total below 0 resists nothing rather than raising the damage.
